$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: Dropdown Menu Content's border is outside its box in Figma, drawn as an outer 1 px shadow.

line.$why: The separator's line is its ::before border, running 4 px past each side like Figma's line.

Avatar.$why: The Avatar component (avatar.css, checked on its own) is round with 50 %; its inner layout differs from Figma's image frame.

items.$why: Figma's items slot is the menu's content box; the code puts the items in the menu directly and the pixels cover their position.
